skills.name: Spin Kick
skills.description: Runs and spin kicks enemies while jumping. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Nullifies debuff-canceling skills (5 sec) *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -50% (5 sec)

skills.name: Charm
skills.description: Takes a charm out of pocket and feels sentimental. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +30% (10 sec) *Resets the Skill cooldown of some allies.

abilities.name: Group: Tokyo Revengers
abilities.description: Tokyo Revengers Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
